name: kurei_idle
desc: Pixel art game sprite, side view, full body from head to tail tip, standing still in a neutral idle pose facing left, all four feet planted flat on the ground, head held level in profile, looking straight ahead to the left in the walking direction. A big, heavy, burly four-legged dragon with a glossy wet clay-like body: shiny teal skin with strong highlights, cream-yellow throat, chest, belly, and underside of the tail. A fairly small head compared to the huge body. A smooth cream chest and a huge, round, heavy cream belly. Thick neck, long sturdy body, thick strong legs with big grey claws. Thick tail ending in a wide fin-shaped tip. Blond hair with long, spiky bangs that fall forward over the forehead and hang down in front of the eye to the cheek, a few pointed tufts on top, and a thin mane running down the neck and back; the hair lies flat and is not puffy. Flat salmon-orange markings painted on the skin: triangle patterns on the back and shoulders, short stripes on the snout, cheeks and front legs. Two dark grey horns at the back of the head, a large curved tan-brown horn growing from the side of the head and curving forward over the top of the eye like the brim of a cap, cream furry ears. Large eyes with clearly visible white sclera, yellow iris, black slit pupil with a small white highlight, heavy half-lidded eyes with a mischievous, teasing, scheming look. The head is shaped like the face reference: a flat forehead and a long, flat snout that tapers gently to a smooth rounded tip, with a long, simple mouth line. The only details on the face are the eye, the mouth line and a small white fang at the corner of the closed mouth, which is curled up in a sly, mischievous smirk. Thick glossy drips of teal and cream goo running down the belly, legs and tail tip, with small puddles on the ground. Plain flat background, the dragon alone.
refs: the character head in side view: copy this head closely - long spiky blond bangs hanging over the forehead and in front of the eye, tan-brown horn over the eye like a cap brim, grey horn, big pointed cream ear, large eye with white sclera and half-lidded look, long rounded snout, mouth line with small fang; ignore the speech bubbles and text

draw the face in the same simple, clean anime style as this drawing - head shape with a flat top and long flat snout, large eyes with clear white sclera, heavy half-lidded mischievous look, light spiky hair; the snout is plain and clean; the head should be drawn a bit smaller relative to the body than here
design reference only for the body: four-legged body, fin-tipped tail, claws, dripping goo; do not copy its pose; the drawing is cute and simplified, so make the body bulkier
